pictures.inspected: Small log hut has a steep weathered-gray gable roof, brown door at left and white-framed window at right of its gable face. The separate lower long log shed has a red hipped metal roof, broad and narrow timber doors and small end vent/panels. Trees/yard/signs remain independent context. This model is the smaller gray-roof hut; the red-roof companion is independent.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete independent small log poultry-house interpretation: slightly irregular mapped walls, white plinth, brown recessed gable door and white-framed divided window, closed timber gables, steep weathered-gray roof with closed eave/fascia thickness, corner log ends and a supported approach stair. Use shared wood_log, wood_plain, wood_vertical, shingle_cedar, plaster_lime and storefront surfaces. The companion red-roof shed remains a separate model; no trees, copied signs, people or photo pixels are baked in.
